notes:
Hand-traced from figures/figure_1.png (front view of the door hinge assembly). UV is normalised image coordinates (origin top-left, u right, v down). depth_mm is the centre depth on the projection's depth_axis (Y for the X-Z front projection). The bboxes are tight to the visible silhouettes in the figure, NOT the median of label callouts.

Key reading of figure 1:
  * The CURVED DOOR PANEL occupies the LEFT third of the figure (a large quadrilateral with a downward-angled bottom edge).
  * The FIXED VEHICLE FRAME is the L-shaped body on the right, also large.
  * The UPPER HINGE cluster is around (u=0.55, v=0.18) — small.
  * The LOWER HINGE cluster is around (u=0.50, v=0.55) — small.
  * The PINTLE PIN runs vertically along u≈0.50 from v≈0.10 to v≈0.85.
  * The POWER MECHANISM (spring + link) is around (u=0.45, v=0.62).
  * Fasteners scattered.

Depth assignments (Y, mm):
  door_panel    Y = -45  (in front)
  fixed_frame   Y = +35  (behind)
  upper_hinge   Y =   0  (on the pintle plane)
  lower_hinge   Y =   0
  pintle_axis   Y =   0
  power_mech    Y = +18  (behind the pintle plane, between hinge and frame)
  fasteners     Y =  -8
